visualReview.method: Actually opened and inspected all four supplied light/dark contact sheets using view_image. Reused parent independent full 58 PNG visual acceptance for unchanged hashes; checked contact sheet silhouettes, interior transparency and absence of adjacent atlas fragments. Modal shade is an intentional constant-alpha runtime primitive. Table background is an opaque full frame. No new generation was requested.
observations: 45 common skins/icons maintain complete silhouettes on light and dark backgrounds; transparent interior in window-frame and hole-bearing icons is correct.
12 cutout gameplay elements have intact silhouettes; avatar-frame and current-player-ring retain transparent centers.
Pressed, selected and disabled button rasters preserve geometry and are visually distinguishable.
Loading-ring/current-player-ring glow is intentional semi-transparent light, not an opaque matte.

limitations: No engine/client integration claimed. Nine-slice stretch behavior is validated by metadata and source appearance, not executed in a client.
No browser execution: prior file:// request was rejected by browser policy; no alternative browser or server attempted.
